result.Method of Attack: Deploy CoinMiner executable on Linux devices by incremental staged payload delivery; Payload concealed in remote scripts fetched via curl and executed in Bash; Downloads config.json for mining configuration and CoinMiner executable; Modifies ~/.bashrc to ensure persistence and reactivation on new shell sessions; Executes CoinMiner in background using nohup
result.Impacted Systems: Linux devices with these malicious packages installed
result.Attack Vector: Import statement triggers payload execution in __init__.py; Remote script fetching and execution; PyPI package installation
